title: Small theorem family
statement: For a Boolean function $f$ on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube, a real number $\varepsilon$, and a nonnegative integer $k$, define the family of subsets $S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$ that are contained in the coordinates whose Boolean influence is at least $\varepsilon^2/I(f)^2\cdot 9^{-k}$ and satisfy $|S|\le k$, where $I(f)$ is the total influence of $f$.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube
